entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Another calling card...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: "Hanae Oda"...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: My mom!?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are targeting[n]my mom...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So she IS bad after all...
She's out of control.
No, she's not.[clr 27]
Is that what you think?[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Like she doesn't have a controller...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah, you might be right... My mom's[n]been acting really strange lately...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She used to be so nice...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Thanks...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But my mom just isn't herself...[n]She used to be so nice...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: My mom used to be nice...[n]but right now, I think...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...She's one of the bad guys.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: To be honest, I've thought that for[n]a while now.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Mom...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Do you think they'll actually be able to[n]change her heart?
It'll all work out.
I can't guarantee it.
Believe in them.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Yeah.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I really hope so...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: My mom won't, um... die or anything,[n]right?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'll believe in the Phantom Thieves...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: They help people in trouble.[n]They wouldn't do anything bad to her.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Yeah. Yeah, you're right. They ARE the[n]Phantom Thieves, after all!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: So...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Someone has to give this to[n]my mom, right?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: ...Okay, I'll do it.
Is it too much for you?
Way to step up.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It IS kind of my fault... that[n]my mom got this way...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She had to deal with a lot,[n]raising me on her own...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She had to get stronger...[n]'cause I was so weak...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But that's not an excuse to[n]hurt the people around her...!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She fights with everyone, about[n]everything, and ends up getting[n]hurt...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: At this rate, my mom's gonna break...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I want my mom to realize that she doesn't[n]have to be strong for me anymore...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: But she won't listen to me when[n]I tell her that...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: That's why I wanna help the Phantom[n]Thieves. I wanna stop my mom.
Let's save her.[clr 27]
That's admirable.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: [lName]-san...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Okay, I'll give her the calling card.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: She's my mom, after all.[n]I really want to help her!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: The next time you see the Phantom[n]Thieves, please tell them I said thank you.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: And thanks for talking to them[n]about this, [lName]-san.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm going to teach you my best,[n]strongest move...
I feel like my bond with[n]Shinya is growing deeper...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh, I guess it's late...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, do me a favor... Don't tell anyone[n]you saw me crying earlier, okay?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Oh, and say hi to the Phantom[n]Thieves for me. Later.
